Bigfoot is safe. Bigfoot is furry, reclusive, herbivorous, non-confrontational. He’s America’s folk monster. You show those files, the public yawns, says "told you so," and closes the book.

The Dogman files are the real payload. And they are not being released. They are being gamed for eventual release, but the informational architecture is far more dangerous. The implications?

So What Would Be The Logical Approach?

The Dogman file, if fully unsealed, would do more than "shake people up." It would:

4. Destroy the credibility of every government agency involved in the denial apparatus FBI, USDA, DOI, DOD, NSA.

IMPORTANT UPDATE ON PENDING LEAD AZIDE DETONATION IN MIDDLETOWN IOWA:

I have been contacted by some brave whistleblowers as we have completed our initial background sampling on soil and surfaces for lead and other potential toxic chemicals in all directions (North, South, East, and West).  This background testing is important to understand so we can compare the additional lead and other toxic chemicals that could be present in any fallout from the plume should the detonation happen .  Pictures of some of our testing from the last 3 days and the team are below.

Here is the latest information I have from whistleblowers who worked for and/or currently work at the Army Base in Middletown, IA:

1. 10 years ago there were 20-25 barrels of lead azide stored in what workers called the igloo or storage building.  Each barrel had one small bag of lead azide, with 2-5 pounds of lead azide in each bag, and each barrel was filled with a mixture of water and alcohol.  How did this go from 20-25 barrels to 68 barrels now?

2. Each month inspectors checked the barrels to make sure the water level was up and the bag was floating.

3.  At some point over the last 10 years, the @usarmy allegedly moved more lead azide, apparently from other military bases that were shut down, into the storage building and also consolidated the lead azide from 2-5 pounds in each barrel to approximately 150 pounds per barrel with a total of 68 barrels of lead azide currently. 

4. There has to be paperwork and records for all of this.  If there are no records the question is what happened to the paperwork and records?

5. Considering the above, this means that the lead azide stored at the Middletown, IA Army Base went from approximately 50-125 pounds to approximately 10,000 pounds in the last 10 years.

At the request of local residents, this is what my team, which consists of me, Dr. Robert Kroutil, and Dr. Mark Thomas as we are all whistleblowers represented by the @GovAcctProj / @lesleyfpacey  has been doing on the ground in and around Middletown, IA: 

1. Over the last 3 days, from Nov 19-21, we took soil and surface samples for background lead and other chemicals from North, South, East, and West of the Army base.  We also took additional samples at the request of residents in and around Middletown, IA.

2. Should the Army move forward with the detonation of lead azide tomorrow or at any point in the future we will have background tests for lead and most of the other possible contaminates to compare the before and after detonation for the impact of any toxic fallout from the plume generated after the explosion.  Unfortunately, intentional explosions never go as planned most of the time, just look at East Palestine OH and the intentional blowing up of vinyl chloride tankers.  

3. As this is a rapidly changing situation and given the pending detonation of lead azide, my testing team plans to have a virtual town hall for the public and affected residents.  We will announce a date and time over the next few days.

4.  We will return for more surface and soil testing should the detonation move forward.

I will be posting more information about our team’s experience and background (from East Palestine, OH Norfolk Southern train derailment and explosion, Conyers, GA  BioLab fire, Moss Landing, CA Vistra lithium ion batter fire, Roseland, LA Smitty’s explosion and fire, Toledo, OH Brent Industries explosion and fire and MC Tank Transport chemical leak, Keyport NJ unlined toxic waster pit, and other chemically impacted communities) under this post for those that are interested in more information.
